content: Generate multiple short clips with separate prompts (e.g., 3 prompts) and then chain/stitch the outputs together to build a longer video in Seedance 2.0.
description:
Ok this was pretty janky, but I am getting a bit better at Seedance 2.0, I can now chain some stuff together. Its not perfect, and tbh I kinda suck at editing videos. 

But this could be really sick for making fan based Animes. 

It even did the music and everything. I didn't do anything other than 3 prompts then sticking it together.  I didn't even get fancy and have it like reference the other videos. 

Its so addicting. I hope they don't nerf this because some amazing stuff will be made.
